2026-10-22

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-22

Overview

On 2026-10-22, the Chromium main branch recorded 1032 total commits, with 833 relevant code updates ranging from (b7b54b5) to (a550a6f). Highlights include security hardening for extension unzipping and HPKE, Mojo and IPC configuration refactors, graphics pipeline optimizations, and sync infrastructure modernization.

Security & Privacy

  • Explicitly disallowed ML-KEM in HPKE Auth mode to prevent potential cryptographic crashes in BoringSSL integration. (ae89152)
    CryptoSecurity
  • Hardened extension unzipping by revoking directory capabilities immediately after execution and unlinking existing manifests before writing to prevent post-unzip tampering. (7a0c3ee)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Expanded File System Access sensitive path blocklists to restrict write access to shell startup files, configuration directories, and .git paths. (d6f2c70)
    StorageSecurity
  • Added active-profile validation checks to global singleton projector clients to prevent cross-profile metadata leaks. (0716919)
    PrivacyChromeOS

Blink & Web Platform

  • Implemented defense-in-depth cross-origin relatedTarget filtering to strip values to null across MouseEvent, PointerEvent, and FocusEvent boundary dispatches under the ClearCrossOriginRelatedTarget flag. (bb79a99)
    BlinkSecurity
  • Refactored HTML5 Canvas and OffscreenCanvas resize flows by moving initialization into Reshape and inlining virtual base methods on CanvasRenderingContext. (37eaf3d) (4af5ce9)
    BlinkHTMLGPU
  • Optimized PlainTextRange::CreateRange() to compute iteration runs linearly instead of quadratically, fixing severe performance regressions during IME typing inside large textareas. (5eade4f)
    BlinkPerformance
  • Refactored AudioWorkletProcessor error propagation to return structured error details instead of string sentinels for improved debugging. (195d9e4)
    BlinkMedia

Graphics & Media

  • Cached Dawn adapter enumeration and device creation results in GpuServiceImpl upon first query to eliminate redundant startup delays during chrome://gpu loads. (2ffdf56)
    GPUPerformance
  • Migrated GLES2 and GLES3 header includes across third_party/blink/renderer from third_party/khronos to third_party/angle/include. (483ade1)
    GPUBlink
  • Updated Windows MediaFoundation video-capture device launchers to deliver frames through shared-image-backed pool slots rather than raw DXGI GMB handles. (3e5db22)
    MediaWindowsGPU

Core Architecture & Mojo

  • Dropped legacy mojo configuration size limits (max_mapping_table_size, max_message_num_bytes, max_shared_memory_num_bytes) as modern runtimes no longer enforce them. (b986854)
    BaseNetwork
  • Enforced self-deletion semantics for content::DocumentService subclasses, mandating instantiation via base::MakeSelfDeleting() to guarantee correct pipe lifetime bindings. (1740410)
    BrowserBase
  • Renamed base::LinkedList to base::UnsafeLinkedList across major subsystems to encourage safer container patterns. (6a1532c)
    Base
  • Gated base::Lock and partition_alloc::internal::Lock ownership tracking behind EXPENSIVE_DCHECKS_ARE_ON to reduce test suite CPU overhead. (5683154)
    BasePerformance

Browser UI, Sync & Platform Integration

  • Updated web app notification permission workflows on macOS to prompt users via standard Chromium UI first before falling back to system-level macOS requests. (3ffe9e2)
    UINotificationsmacOS
  • Eliminated the subframe shutdown delay and unload timer when discarding tabs, enabling immediate process termination. (9aa019b)
    BrowserPerformance
  • Removed legacy sync confirmation flows and UI classes, completing the transition of desktop platforms fully to History Sync opt-ins. (b19bc92)
    SyncProfiles
  • Added support for compiling iOS Simulator targets natively on Linux hosts via updated GN toolchain configurations. (d0a2620)
    iOSLinuxBuild

2026-10-21

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-21

Overview

On 2026-10-21, the Chromium main branch received 899 commits, of which 741 were relevant after filtering ((8fe8d65), (c83f6c5)). The day was dominated by a large wave of API removals and embedder-facing signature changes: Shared Storage, Top-Level Storage Access, Related Website Sets, per-widget software compositing, trichrome Android targets, and several ContentBrowserClient / base::FeatureList / iOS public API changes. Beyond the breaking changes, work included security hardening, JNI handle modernization, performance improvements, extensive test infrastructure cleanup, and flag removals.

⚠️ Breaking Changes — Embedder APIs

  • ⚠️Removal of per-widget software compositing: force_software_compositing deleted from views::Widget::InitParams and the force_software_compositor parameter removed from aura::WindowTreeHost::CreateCompositor(); viz FrameSinkManager mojom updated. Embedders (Headless, Ash, custom native widgets) using these will fail to compile; widgets now follow the shared GPU/software compositing policy. (0435c36)
    UICompositorGPU
  • ⚠️Shared Storage API removal completed (three-part series): ContentBrowserClient::OnSharedStorageWorkletHostCreated()/OnSharedStorageSelectURLCalled() removed; SharedStorageBudgetMetadata removed from FencedFrameConfig/FencedFrameProperties and fenced-frame selectURL plumbing deleted (~850 lines); BrowsingDataModel::StorageType::kSharedStorage, storage::kSharedStoragePath, browsing-data-remover masks, and chrome://inspect worklet targets removed. (0289254) (a431c50) (e3e3e05)
    StoragePrivacyBrowser
  • ⚠️Top-Level Storage Access plumbing removed from stable APIs: net::CookieSettingOverride::kTopLevelStorageAccessGrantEligible, ExemptionReason::kTopLevelStorageAccess, ContentSettingsType::TOP_LEVEL_STORAGE_ACCESS, and the cookie_manager mojom plumbing all deleted. Embedders referencing these (e.g., Chromecast) must update. (75b7b36)
    NetworkStorageBrowser
  • ⚠️Related Website Sets (First-Party Sets) core removed: public content::FirstPartySetsHandler interface, ContentBrowserClient::WillProvidePublicFirstPartySets()/SetIsMinimalMode(), the FPS component updater registration, and the kStorageAccessAPIRelatedWebsiteSets feature deleted (~8.6k lines). RWS-decided Storage Access API grants are now unconditionally deleted on startup. (845d377)
    BrowserNetworkStorage
  • ⚠️Windows ContentBrowserClient API changed: GetChildModule() and the ChildModule struct removed from //content; PreSpawnChild() drops the child_module parameter; new GetRendererSandboxPolicyExtension(ChildProcessId) virtual added; GetChildProcessPath() now takes a ChildProcessId. Embedders overriding these must update implementations. (5860166)
    BrowserSecurityWindows
  • ⚠️base::FeatureList runtime-mutability callback signature changed: OnRuntimeMutableFeatureStateChangedCallback now receives bool old_is_enabled, bool new_is_enabled instead of base::FeatureList::OverrideState. Embedders registering runtime-mutable feature callbacks must update signatures. (96102b3)
    BaseBrowser
  • ⚠️WebSharedWorker::CreateAndStart()/StartWorkerContext() signature changed: a permissions_policy parameter was added and is_cross_origin_isolated renamed to cross_origin_isolated. Embedders creating shared workers must update call sites (behavior behind a flag, but the signature change is unconditional). (1c9716f)
    BlinkServiceWorkerNavigation
  • ⚠️iOS certificate policy API privatized: web::CertPolicy removed from the public ios/web/public/security/ API; CertificatePolicyCache converted to a pure abstract interface with a private CertificatePolicyCacheImpl. Embedder code using CertPolicy or instantiating CertificatePolicyCache must be updated. (1140de6)
    iOSSSLBrowser
  • ⚠️Android trichrome GN targets removed: trichrome_chrome_*/trichrome_library_* targets deleted from chrome/android/BUILD.gn along with ~6,200 lines of expectation files. Android build pipelines referencing these public targets will break. (9c01668)
    AndroidBuild
  • ⚠️Declarative Net Request behavioral change (enabled by default): rules matching response header values (values/excludedValues) now require host permissions; such rules are skipped entirely without host access. kIndexedRulesetFormatVersion bumped 36 → 37 (rulesets must be re-serialized). Kill switch: kDeclarativeNetRequestRestrictResponseHeaderValueMatching. (22a2af9)
    ExtensionsNetworkSecurity

Web Platform & Blink

  • Shipped features: OfflineAudioContext incremental rendering and close() (I2S complete); SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets for Isolated Web Apps (sourceAddress on joinGroup()/leaveGroup()). Also ::interest-button now triggers interest on long-press (experimental Interest Invokers) and CSS Values 5 progress() no-clamp keyword behind a runtime flag. (4c7feeb) (8774e07) (7d77af6) (59da575)
    BlinkMediaCSS

2026-10-20

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-20

Overview

Summary of 936 commits on the Chromium main branch for 2026-10-20, focusing on 739 relevant changes spanning UI, Blink, Security, and Infrastructure. Ranging from commit (7769692) to (bcc3463).

UI Architecture & Views

  • Migrated WindowOpenDisposition from a native C++ enum to a Mojo enum alias (using WindowOpenDisposition = ui::mojom::WindowOpenDisposition;) to facilitate incremental Mojo interface transitions. (84278ec)
    UIBase
  • Renamed views::ViewShadow to views::ViewDecoration across ui/views/, ash/, and chrome/browser/ui/views/ to support new decoration decoration and highlight border features. (63a7b8d)
    UIAsh
  • Added ScopedDeletionGuard and ViewTracker safeguards inside MenuController to prevent use-after-free bugs caused by synchronous accessibility callbacks destroying menus mid-dispatch. (850273e)
    UIAccessibility

Blink Engine & Web APIs

  • Updated Incremental Font Transfer (IFT) shaping logic to verify glyph availability directly against the base font before requesting network patches. (c229f16)
    BlinkFonts
  • Standardized timestamp string conversions in MediaControlTimelineElement using String::NumberToStringEcmaScript() to resolve floating-point rounding mismatches with SetDuration(). (bcc3463)
    BlinkMedia
  • Replaced Focusable.shadowHost with Focusable.shadowHostChain and renamed FocusableOptions.shadowRoots to exposedShadowRoots to clarify exposed shadow root caller configurations. (aa086e6)
    BlinkHTML

Security, Content & Android WebView

  • Removed custom URL exemptions in AwContentBrowserClient::IsHandledURL for file:///android_asset/ and file:///android_res/, routing all special asset requests through standard browser permission checks. (43944d3)
    AndroidSecurity
  • Implemented a server-authentication mechanism on client Mach channels via NamedPlatformChannel and ChannelMac to prevent bootstrap name squatting vulnerabilities on macOS. (13391ee)
    SecuritymacOS
  • Introduced embedder hooks via ContentBrowserClient::IsContentSchemeURLNavigationAllowed() to block unauthorized web-initiated navigations to unexported internal Android content providers. (50dd531)
    AndroidSecurityBrowser

Performance & Base Utilities

  • Overhauled Android Omnibox View Binders (BaseSuggestionViewBinder, etc.) to eliminate redundant layout passes, remove duplicate measure() calls, and cache icon tinting resources. (1aac433)
    AndroidUIPerformance
  • Added GetOrCreate() helper functions to base/containers/map_util.h leveraging lower_bound() and emplace_hint() for efficient single-traversal tree additions with heterogeneous keys. (dfc51a6)
    BasePerformance
  • Gated expensive PartitionAlloc validation routines behind EXPENSIVE_DCHECKS_ARE_ON instead of standard DCHECK_IS_ON() to reduce CQ release trybuilder CPU overhead. (ea7dba5)
    BasePerformanceTesting

Infrastructure, Testing & Build Tools

  • Replaced apkanalyzer with a pure Python dex size attribution engine (dex.py) that parses R8 mapping files and matches residual signatures, improving build speed and memory consumption. (cb97b87)
    AndroidBuildInfra
  • Expanded Clang AllocToken allocator instrumentation globally by linking weak fallback stubs across all binaries to ensure components without explicit allocator shim dependencies remain supported. (2123f8d)
    BuildInfra
  • Rolled the third-party SQLite source tree to incorporate upstream fixes up to release version 3.54.1. (1c20eee)
    StorageInfra

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-18

Overview

This digest covers **17 commits** landed on Chromium main between (8268365) (r1721458, oldest) and (8540730) (r1721554, newest) on 2026-10-18. After detailed diff review, **no commits were confirmed as major breaking changes to stable public APIs**: the notable changes are either gated behind new features/flags, internal cleanups, bug fixes restoring correct behavior, or confined to experimental surfaces (e.g. the experimental CDP Autofill domain). The most embedder-relevant items are the CDP mouse-wheel delta scaling fix, the revert of the extension request_initiator validation after a crash, and the ui/display/display.h include reduction, none of which rise to a stable-API break.

Enterprise & Security

  • Extension actor attribution for enterprise download events: ReportingEventRouter now populates Event.initiator.chrome_extension on dangerous-download, sensitive-data and unscanned-file security events. ContentAnalysisInfoBase gains a pure virtual extension_initiator() (stubbed on iOS, defaulted to nullopt on desktop), with DownloadContentAreaUserProvider overriding it via GetExtensionInitiatorInfo(). Entirely gated behind the new kEnterpriseExtensionActorAttribution feature (disabled by default); the initiator is an optional trailing parameter so existing callers are unchanged. Safe Browsing download_protection/ call sites land in a follow-up CL. (d6712da)
    EnterpriseDownloadsSecurity
  • Revert of extension protocol initiator validation: Reverts cb9257ea ('Validate request_initiator in loader factory') which was identified as the likely cause of a production crash (crash/6f3cea7808400000). This restores the previous ExtensionURLLoaderFactory behavior and removes the kValidateExtensionResourceRequestInitiator kill-switch path from extensions/browser/extension_protocols.cc and related files — a crash-driven rollback, not a new break. (8de7ce3)
    ExtensionsSecurityNetwork
  • CORS credentials restored for disable_web_security factories: url_loader_util::SetRequestCredentials() now receives URLLoaderFactoryParams::disable_web_security (on initial configuration and redirects) and allows CredentialsMode::kSameOrigin credentials and client certificates for cross-origin targets when web security is disabled — fixing a regression where credentials were incorrectly dropped for --disable-web-security and Android WebView's allow_universal_access_from_file_urls file:// origins. Guarded by the enabled-by-default kill switch kAllowSameOriginCredentialsWithDisableWebSecurity. This is a bug fix restoring correct behavior for a debugging/WebView mode, not a stable API change. (643bad1)
    NetworkSecurity

DevTools & Automation

  • CDP wheel-event delta scaling fixed for zoomed frames: Input.dispatchMouseEvent (mouseWheel) deltas — specified in CSS pixels — are now scaled by the target's browser zoom, CSS zoom and pinch scale, and nonfinite/overflowing scaled values are rejected with an InvalidParams response ('Wheel deltas exceed the supported range'). Additionally, DOM pixel-mode wheel deltas are normalized for inherited pinch zoom in child widgets via a new FrameWidget::GetExternalPageScaleFactor() virtual (internal Blink platform interface), covered by the stable runtime rollback feature WheelEventDeltaExternalPageScale. This aligns CDP behavior with its specification (a bug fix); automation clients that manually compensated for zoom may see different scroll distances, but no API was removed or signature changed. (b629151)
    DevToolsBlink
  • WebDriver BiDi autofill.trigger implemented: New AutofillProcessor in chromium-bidi maps the spec-defined autofill.trigger command to CDP Autofill.trigger, with generated autofill module types from the WICG autofill-event spec and validation that exactly one of card/address is provided. On the CDP side, Autofill.trigger now responds only after values have been applied to form fields (it waits for form extraction in all frames over the same mojom::AutofillAgent pipes), so clients can read filled values without polling. Note the CDP Autofill domain remains experimental, so the response-timing change is not a stable-API break. (dc8635a)
    DevToolsAutofill

V8 & Build

  • Respect --disallow-v8-feature-flag-overrides for configurable DCHECKs: In dcheck_is_configurable builds, RenderProcessImpl no longer overrides V8's --turbo_verify, --turbo_verify_allocation and --debug_code flags when base::kDCheckIsFatalFeature is disabled and V8 flag overrides are disallowed. This fixes kFlagsMismatch rejections of build-time-bundled WebUI code caches (e.g. TabSearch) on win-dcheck builders — an internal build/test-infrastructure fix. (8e030ab)
    V8Build

ChromeOS / Ash

  • New BrowserDelegate::SetImmersiveAllowedWhileTrustedPinned: Adds a method to the chromeos::ash_components BrowserDelegate interface, used by LockedSessionWindowTracker::OnPauseModeChanged to remove Boca On Task's dependency on //chrome/browser/ui/views/frame:browser_view_header. An additive change to an internal ChromeOS-layer interface; no removals or signature changes. (d15c705)
    ChromeOSAsh
  • DEPS hygiene sweep: Purged unnecessary + include rules across ~16 DEPS files under chrome/browser/ash subdirectories (app_list, child_accounts, eche_app, file_manager, fileapi, game_mode, input_method, login, policy, system_web_apps). Pure dependency-metadata cleanup. (ee53622)
    ChromeOSBuild

Android UI

  • Glic/Tab bottom-sheet edge-to-edge layout (behind the TabBottomSheetEdgeToEdge feature): TabBottomSheetContent gains a coversBottomControls() override so the sheet extends to the screen bottom, BottomSheetCoordinator/BottomSheetMediator adjust viewport and container heights/padding for edge-to-edge bottom insets, and the bottom safe-area inset is propagated to WebContents via BottomSheetController#getEdgeToEdgeBottomInset(). Feature-gated Android UI work with no public API removals. (c1b7ecc)
    AndroidUI

Desktop UI & Settings

  • Settings WebUI cleanup in site_settings_mixin_lit.ts: toUrl() now wraps URL construction in try/catch to return null for invalid URLs as documented, wildcard schemes (*://) and subdomain wildcards ([*.]) are filtered in a single pass, obsolete sorting/boundary TODOs replaced with explanatory comments, and SiteSettingSource enum coverage is verified in ExpandSiteException tests. Internal WebUI test-helper refactoring. (04aeb5d)
    UIBrowser
  • Read Anything controller dead-code cleanup: Removed the unused side_panel_registry_ member, forward-declared SidePanelRegistry in read_anything_controller.h instead of including its header, dropped 6 unused includes plus 3 GN deps, and corrected the stale ReadAnythingUntrustedUI lifetime comment (the controller now owns its WebContents). Internal cleanup only. (ce164a5)
    UIBrowser
  • Header hygiene in ui/display/display.h: The ui/gfx/display_color_spaces.h include was replaced with forward declarations (gfx::ColorSpace, gfx::DisplayColorSpaces, gfx::DisplayColorSpacesRef) to shrink this widely-included header, with IWYU fixes across dependents (display_change_notifier.cc, display_list.cc, managed_display_info.h, cursor_manager.cc, several unittests). No API changes, but downstream embedders that relied on the transitive include may need to add #include "ui/gfx/display_color_spaces.h" explicitly — a build-hygiene adjustment, not a stable-API break. (820c012)
    UIPerformance

iOS

  • iOS Privacy settings fix: PrivacyTableViewController now retrieves and passes the profile's UniversalOptOutService to ShouldShowUniversalOptOutSettings instead of nullptr, so eligibility checks cover both signed-in and signed-out states rather than falling back to the prefs-only (signed-out) check. Bug fix (crbug 574322632) with no interface changes. (30b48c5)
    iOSPrivacyUI

History & Storage

  • Single-query Journeys history lookups: JourneysDatabase gains methods that resolve the history entries of one or all journeys with a single query joining journeys with visits and urls (previously two queries per entry: GetLastRowForVisitByVisitTime + GetURLRow), preserving existing semantics (largest visit ID per timestamp, i.e. end of redirect chain; invalid URL rows count as missing) and reporting per-entry whether the visit or URL row is missing. Resolution switches over in a follow-up CL; purely additive internal database API. (038174a)
    HistoryStorage

Media & Third-Party

  • libvpx roll 63bcd588b..37f48364a (2 upstream commits): clang-format-21 applied and VP9 now disallows SVC config for 2-pass encoding with legacy code removed. Routine third-party dependency roll. (6a9c9f3)
    MediaBuild

Testing

  • WebCodecs GPU test expectations: Skipped 720p 1.5 Mbps VBR rate-control tests on Pixel 10/11, whose hardware encoders enforce a minimum VBR bitrate floor of 2.2 Mbps (AVC) and 2.0 Mbps (HEVC). Test-only change. (7d8f103)
    TestingGPUMedia

Infra & i18n

  • Routine translation (XTB) updates for Hindi and Urdu strings across chromium_strings, generated_resources, google_chrome_strings, components_strings, Android Chrome/Webapps strings and iOS strings. Automated translation-dump commit with a noted unavoidable binary-size increase. (caef9db)
    I18nInfra

Overview

A total of 669 commits landed on the Chromium main branch on 2026-10-12, of which 492 were analyzed as relevant. The day was dominated by internal refactoring (a large GN dependency-hygiene campaign, the TabFeatures migration, canvas/SharedImage usage-flag cleanup), extensive test gardening, and heavy AI/Glic/Actor feature work. Two embedder-facing breaking changes were confirmed: a ContentBrowserClient child-module API change and a Global Privacy Control content API change. First commit: (e3c2b8b), last commit: (7a83bdf).

(60ab1ad)
    PrivacyBlinkDevTools

Overview

This digest covers **37 commits** from 2026-09-27, ranging from (1498cf2) (revert of a Contextual Tasks integration test) to (0784c35) (Ash shelf window previews). Detailed diff review of the highest-risk candidates — the (ddb2447) and the omnibox enum-class conversions — confirmed **no major breaking changes to stable public APIs**: WebMCP remains an experimental, flag-gated API (RuntimeEnabled=WebMCP), and the enum conversions are internal C++ modernization. The day's activity was dominated by AV1 encoder bitstream conformance fixes, internal migration of six tab helpers to the new TabFeatures architecture, macOS VoiceOver accessibility fixes, and stability/performance work.

Media & AV1 Encoder Fixes

  • Fixed a series of AV1 bitstream conformance bugs in the hardware encoder (media/gpu/av1_builder.cc): allow_warped_motion is now written on inter frames when the sequence enables warped motion, skip_mode_present is emitted when skipModeAllowed evaluates true, and frame-header elements implied by frame type (error_resilient_mode, refresh_frame_flags, frame_size_override_flag, gated use_ref_frame_mvs/primary_ref_frame/reference_select/global motion, use_superres inside frame_size()) are correctly inferred. Each omission or extra bit previously shifted every subsequent syntax element. (380c6e4) (a33531d) (99868f2)
    MediaGPU
  • Additional AV1 conformance fixes: loop filter, CDEF and tx mode are now gated on CodedLossless and loop restoration on AllLossless (lossless frames reachable from WebCodecs with quantizer 0 previously wrote syntax that desynchronized the header); separate_uv_delta_q moved to the sequence header per spec 5.5.2; and fixed-size leb128 padding is now properly terminated with dchecks against truncation. (0046509) (15fd67d) (5a7d254)
    MediaGPU

WebMCP (Experimental Web API)

  • Added document.modelContext.ontoolactivated and ontoolcancel event handler attributes with new ToolActivatedEvent/ToolCancelEvent types, as part of a transition to standardized event attributes per [spec PR #146](https://github.com/webmachinelearning/webmcp/pull/146). (776ddbf) (aa45bc8)
    BlinkAI
  • Removed the WebMCPEvent interface and its WebMCPEventInit dictionary from Blink (~182 deletions); toolactivated/toolcancel events are now dispatched on document.modelContext via the dedicated event classes instead of on window. Not a stable-API break: WebMCP is an in-development, flag-gated API (RuntimeEnabled=WebMCP) still evolving through spec PRs. (ddb2447)
    BlinkAI

Tab Architecture Refactoring (Internal)

  • Continued migration of WebContentsUserData tab helpers to the new TabFeatures/TabFeaturesAndroid architecture: TailoredSecurityUrlObserver, SiteProtectionMetricsObserver, NavigationMetricsRecorder, NavigationPredictorPreconnectClient, NoStatePrefetchTabHelper, and ExternalProtocolObserver were moved off WebContentsUserData inheritance and out of TabHelpers::AttachTabHelpers.     BrowserTabs

  • Converted AutocompleteProvider::Type from an unscoped C-style enum to a scoped enum class (72 files, e.g. TYPE_DOCUMENT → Type::kDocument with explicit static_cast<int> for bitmask ops), and AutocompleteMatchType to scoped omnibox::AutocompleteMatchType (205 files, e.g. CALCULATOR → kCalculator).   • Fixed a NOTREACHED crash in ThumbnailSchedulerImpl::Schedule by keeping ThumbnailReadinessTracker in kNotReady while a WebContents is discarded (preventing hover-triggered reloads of discarded tabs), and hardened the scheduler against state corruption by updating is_capturing before scheduler callbacks and resetting capture priority to kNone in RemoveTab(). Chromium Digest: 2026-09-23

Overview

A total of 852 commits landed on the Chromium main branch on 2026-09-23, of which 664 were relevant after filtering ((20d60c9), (71c913d)). The day's headline change is the removal of the Fenced Frames web platform feature, alongside breaking signature changes to gfx::NativePixmap::ScheduleOverlayPlane, blink::WebBlobInfo, and CrxDownloader. The rest of the day was dominated by internal refactoring (Bedrock build modularization, BrowserWindowFeatures migration), security/privacy hardening, and numerous bug fixes.

Breaking Changes

  • ⚠️Fenced Frames removed. The window.fence JS API (Fence, fence.idl, fence_event.idl) is deleted, along with Mojo reporting beacon methods on LocalFrameHost, content::FencedFrame/FencedDocumentData, RenderFrameHostImpl::GetFencedFrames()/DestroyFencedFrame(), SiteInstanceImpl::CreateForFencedFrame, and WebRemoteFrameImpl::CreateForFencedFrame. ~5,454 lines removed across 162 files; embedders relying on fenced frame APIs (beacons, MPArch frame hosting) must update. <fencedframe>/FencedFrameConfig stubs remain. (55fa5f2)
    BlinkNavigationSecurity
  • ⚠️gfx::NativePixmap::ScheduleOverlayPlane signature changed from (widget, overlay_plane_data, vector<GpuFence> acquire, vector<GpuFence> release) to (widget, overlay_plane_data, gfx::GpuFenceHandle acquire_fence). All ozone platform subclasses (cast, drm, wayland, flatland, headless) and callers like GLSurfaceOverlay were updated; custom NativePixmap implementers must migrate. (9273584)
    GPUGraphics
  • ⚠️blink::WebBlobInfo public API trimmed. The Uuid() accessor and three BLINK_EXPORT constructors (two mojo-remote constructors and the (BlobDataHandle, type, size) constructor) were removed. Embedders should migrate to BlobDataHandle::Create and GetBlobHandle()->Uuid(). (710b60c)
    BlinkStorage
  • ⚠️CrxDownloader API change. set_progress_callback() is removed; ProgressCallback is now a required parameter of StartDownload()/StartDownloadFromUrl(). Updater embedders must update call sites; the change also fixes fallback downloaders not receiving progress callbacks. (65a5621)
    UpdaterDownloads
  • Android ContextMenuParams rename (borderline). getAdditionalNavigationParams() renamed to takeAdditionalNavigationParams() with take-semantics (field nulled after take) to fix a use-after-free in deferred context-menu actions. Direct replacement exists; Android embedders should update. (04640c8)
    AndroidTabs

Web Platform & Blink

  • Single-axis scroll containers enabled by default (Intent to Ship): overflow can now make an element a scroll container on a single axis; clip + scrollable overflow no longer computes to hidden. Web-visible behavioral change via standard process. (e8bea17)
    CSSBlink
  • CSS image/font resources now cached per-document ResourceFetcher instead of shared per-stylesheet, fixing a CSP bypass where a second same-origin document reused another document's fetch. Gated behind StyleResourceFetcherIdentityCheck, on by default. (52abc6b)
    CSSSecurityBlink
  • RTC diagnostic logging API implemented as static methods on RTCPeerConnection per spec, keeping the old navigator.rtc methods for compatibility (additive). (fce3006)
    WebRTCBlink
  • Perf: O(1) fast-path for createElement/createElementNS for standard HTML/SVG/MathML elements, and skipping ChildListMutationAccumulator allocation for unobserved nodes (2–5% SPA improvements, ~1% Speedometer 3). (221aee1) (83e8977)
    BlinkPerformance
  • Spec-compliance fixes: CDATA handling at HTML/MathML integration points; SharedArrayBuffers disallowed in postMessage transferables; Observable::when() cross-world error leak fixed; Streams [[disturbed]] set in ReadableStreamPipeTo; createPattern() respects image orientation; WebAuthn deduplicates repeated credential hints. Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-22

Overview

Daily development digest for Chromium on 2026-09-22, covering 857 total commits (697 relevant changes) ranging from commit (23a493c) to (23c2631).

Core Architecture, Content & Process Management

  • Exposed the isolate interrupt method directly on the RenderProcessHost interface and implemented it in MockRenderProcessHost to eliminate unsafe static downcasts from WebContentsImpl to RenderProcessHostImpl. (6f3ccc8)
    BrowserBase
  • Hardened ForSecurityDropFullscreen callers across //content by revalidating frames, checking weak pointers, and adding delegate validation to prevent state corruption when nested message loops exit fullscreen. (e30ba49)
    BrowserSecurity
  • Propagated navigation initiator origins and renderer-initiated states across the Android JNI boundary via ServiceTabLauncher to enforce correct fetch metadata and SameSite cookie restrictions. (4c82791)
    AndroidNavigationNetwork

Web APIs, Blink & Media

  • Fixed persistent retention bugs and improper tail processing cleanup in AnalyserHandler. Added strongly-typed span accessors (planar_channel_cast and interleaved_data_cast) to AudioBuffer, and refactored StereoPanner. (fb3282b) (db8423f) (080d642)
    BlinkMedia
  • Implemented relative manifest ID resolution against document base URLs for both navigator.install() and the <install> element, and updated Web Speech API result events to stamp execution times. (1907a33) (8a8a166)
    BlinkHTML
  • Added AudioBus::TryCreate static factory methods to support fallible memory allocations and return nullptr on failure rather than crashing via PartitionAlloc OOM. (25fdb36)
    BaseMediaPerformance
  • Ensured scrollend events are properly enqueued and fired after layout scroll clamping and anchoring adjustments, and refactored Blink's unicode_utilities.cc to route NFC normalization through IcuBridge. (5df6fb0) (ae5ab06)
    BlinkCSS

UI/UX & WebUI Enhancements

  • Integrated notification prioritization to limit the app menu to a single non-upgrade notification and added global error notification states. (051ac9d) (d25880a) (ebedd92)
    UINotifications
  • Optimized FindBarController to create its FindBar lazily on first use rather than proactively during setup. (4093021)
    UIPerformance
  • Restricted theme focus handlers strictly to :focus-visible to prevent tooltips from unexpectedly triggering on mouse clicks. (8771430)
    UIAccessibility
  • Completely removed the Related Website Sets settings toggle from the cookies page alongside its WebUI code, strings, and prefs allowlist entries. (1444be6)
    PrivacySettingsUI

Network, Security & Storage

  • Configured subresource fetches from cross-site contexts created via StorageAccessHandle shared workers to use cross-site SiteForCookies (sending SameSite=None and 3P CHIPS cookies). (ada1d28) (b014067)
    NetworkStorageSecurity
  • Optimized History database initialization by opening in exclusive locking mode from the start, effectively removing the last production use of sql::Database::AttachDatabase(). (63f2839)
    HistoryStoragePerformance
  • Restricted the GPU process's access to shared Darwin per-user directories on macOS to specific subdirectories required by the Metal compiler and CoreML model compiler. (24042e7)
    GPUSecuritymacOS
  • Added kDomStorageSqliteMigration to enable asynchronous, non-blocking background migration of legacy LevelDB DOMStorage databases to SQLite. (bd73d6f)
    StoragePerformance

Infrastructure, Testing & Performance

  • Optimized tools/ PRESUBMIT scripts by integrating InputApi.HasAffectedFiles() to early-return out of linter and test loops when no relevant sub-paths are altered. (f6c1780)
    InfraTesting
  • Introduced ScudoPurgeCoordinator and the kPeriodicScudoPurge feature to handle periodic memory purging via mallopt(M_PURGE) on Android. (6b03682)
    AndroidBasePerformance
  • Reordered memory access instructions in INFLATE_CHUNK_READ_64LE to separate input stream loads from Huffman table lookups, enabling modern out-of-order CPUs to execute independent memory loads concurrently (~8% throughput improvement). (ea7f420)
    PerformanceBase
  • Disabled LLVM AArch64 GlobalMerge passes on macOS arm64 to ensure code profile counters do not break section page alignment and prevent startup memory map corruption. (45ebeca)
    BuildmacOSPerformance
